title: 第11章 刀法小成第12章 生变
content_zh:
“行啊，苏牧，前两日我还以为你是运气好，没想到今日你竟然能打这么大一只鹿。”
猎帮的管事孙大招啧啧称奇道，“照这么下去，下次你岂不是能打一头野猪回来？”
“孙爷过奖了。”
苏牧腼腆地说道，“野猪可是只有最顶尖的猎户才能打得着，我还差得远呢。”
“你才多大？”
孙大招笑呵呵地说道，“依我看，你早晚会成为武陵城最好的猎户。
不对，现在这武陵城中就没几个猎户比你强了。”
他倒是没什么嫉妒心理，苏牧打到的猎物越多，他赚得也就越多。
他巴不得苏牧打到更多的猎物呢。
孙大招的做事风格与柴帮的张冲不一样，虽然同样是压榨，但是他向来不吝啬好话。
反正说几句好听的也没啥损失。
“我是真没想到，一个月前你还连把弓都没有，我当时还觉得你打猎是异想天开。
没想到这才一个月，武陵城不敢说，南城区的所有猎户当中，你绝对是这个！”
孙大招竖起大拇指。
每日出城打猎的猎户不少，但像苏牧一样，每日都能有收获的并不多，更何况，这几日苏牧的收获还越来越多。
今日苏牧竟然背了一只鹿回来。
一头这么大的鹿，少说也能卖七八两银子，孙大招起码能赚三四两，他能不高兴？
孙大招没见过苏牧打猎，不过从猎物上来看，苏牧绝对是南城区数得上号的猎户。
“我爹以前也是猎户，我自幼就学打猎，现在只是把以前的技艺捡起来了而已。”
苏牧编了个借口，说道。

“家学渊源啊，好小子，我看好你，好好干，武陵城第一猎户，早晚是你的。”
孙大招给了苏牧三两银子，拍了拍苏牧的肩膀，好话不要钱地说了一箩筐。
苏牧波澜不惊地把银子收起来，对孙大招拱拱手，然后向着家的方向走去。
背后一片羡慕嫉妒的目光注视着苏牧，一直等他走进巷子，那些人才收回目光。
“孙兄。”
苏牧刚刚离开，便有一个人来到了猎帮，对着孙大招打起了招呼。
“刘海啊，你来得正好，我刚刚收了一头野鹿，你们酒楼要不要？”
“要，当然要，有些达官贵人就喜欢这口野味。”
刘海连忙说道，他就是看到这野鹿才过来的。
“咱们这老关系，九两银子卖给你。”
孙大招说道。
刘海痛快地答应了下来，这么大一头野鹿，能整治出来不少菜肴。
那些喜欢这口的达官显贵根本就不在乎钱。
“说起来，刘海你跟这鹿也是有缘，知道是谁打的吗？”
content_en:
"Okay, Su Mu, I thought you were lucky two days ago, but I didn't expect you to be able to kill such a big deer today."
Sun Dazhao, the manager of the hunting gang, clicked his tongue and said in wonder, "If this continues, won't you be able to hunt down a wild boar next time?"
"Master Sun, thank you very much."
Su Mu said shyly, "Only the best hunters can hunt wild boar. I'm still far behind."
"How old are you?"
Sun Dazhao said with a smile, "In my opinion, sooner or later you will become the best hunter in Wuling City.
No, there are few hunters in Wuling City who are better than you. "
He didn't feel jealous at all. The more prey Su Mu caught, the more he earned.
He wished that Su Mu could catch more prey.
Sun Dazhao's work style is different from Zhang Chong of the Chai Gang. Although he is also oppressive, he has never been stingy with good words.
Anyway, there is nothing to lose by saying a few nice words.
"I really didn't expect that a month ago you didn't even have a bow. At that time, I thought your hunting was fanciful.
Unexpectedly, it has only been a month, and Wulingcheng dare not say that among all the hunters in Nancheng District, you are definitely the one! "
Sun Dazhao gave a thumbs up.
There are many hunters who go out to hunt in the city every day, but like Su Mu, not many can harvest every day. What's more, Su Mu's harvest has been increasing in recent days.
Today, Su Mu actually came back with a deer on his back.
A deer of this size could be sold for seven or eight taels of silver at least. Sun Dazhao could earn at least three or four taels of silver. How could he be unhappy?
Sun Dazhao had never seen Su Mu hunting, but judging from the prey, Su Mu was definitely one of the best hunters in Nancheng District.
"My father was also a hunter before. I have been learning to hunt since I was a child. Now I just picked up my old skills."
Su Mu made up an excuse and said.
"You have a good family background, good boy. I think highly of you. If you work hard, the number one hunter in Wuling City will be yours sooner or later."
Sun Dazhao gave Su Mu three taels of silver, patted Su Mu on the shoulder, and said a lot of nice things for free.
Su Mu calmly put away the money, bowed his hand to Sun Dazhao, and walked towards home.
Behind him, people looked at Su Mu with envy and jealousy. They didn't look away until he walked into the alley.
"Brother Sun."
Just as Su Mu left, a man came to the hunting gang and greeted Sun Dazhao.
"Liu Hai, you came just in time. I just collected a wild deer. Do you want it in your restaurant?"
"Yes, of course. Some dignitaries like this game."
Liu Hai quickly said that he came here just after seeing the wild deer.
"We have an old relationship and I'll sell it to you for nine taels of silver."
Sun Dazhao said.
Liu Hai happily agreed. Such a big wild deer can prepare a lot of dishes.
Those dignitaries who like this don't care about money at all.
"Speaking of which, Liu Hai and this deer are also related to you. Do you know who shot it?"
